text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the fan meetup in the 
shopping district. Special Week is also 
participating, so while I was waiting for 
her—
—Ta-ta~ra, ta-ta-ra-ta~♪ Te~te-te~te~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Bwahahahahaha!! Special Week has arrived! 
You may approach, you may approach!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... It's only natural to dress 
like this. Because starting right now, I'm 
going to be the supreme commander on 
stage!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I heard about it yesterday by chance! 
Apparently, one of the actors in the play 
Opera O-san is doing today dropped out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The moment I heard the role was 'Shogun', 
this Racewear crossed my mind... and it 
hit me! This... was destiny!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And before I knew it... I had volunteered 
to be the understudy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And so, the show's about to start! 
Trainer, please make sure to watch!

Special Week looks full of confidence, 
but... I can't help feeling anxious. 
Considering she was only picked as an 
understudy yesterday, she might not even 
know her lines yet...
choice_data_list:
Are you going to be okay with the script 
and everything?

Are you sure you're okay with the script 
and stuff?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's all good! I'm told Opera O-san will 
handle the key moments, so I can just 
freely ad-lib like a supreme commander!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've gotta go get ready! See you 
later, Trainer!

Looking in the direction she ran off to, I 
see a giant cardboard set erected in a 
corner of the shopping district. ...For 
now, I decide to watch the play unfold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—O Father~ Will you truly not approve of 
this engagement under any circumstances~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um... No, no, absolutely not! I will never 
accept this! Not a chance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Why is that~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's, well, you know, as the 
Supreme Commander... kinda lame, or should 
I say...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, General! Is it because of my humble 
birth?! Are you saying I am no match for 
your noble lineage?!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-That is so! My clan is amazing, you 
know! And I am, I am... umm...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...I could totally eat 50 bowls of 
tendon, 50 bowls of ramen, and like 50 
pieces of fried chicken! Oh, and 10 
buckets of pudding for dessert!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-How's that! Think thou canst imitate 
this?! If not, then it's no good, I say!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, oh no... I can't do this!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now that it's come to this...! Princess!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Won't you flee with me to a distant land? 
Won't you take my hand and plunge into the 
surging waves of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Father dear~ Why am I not allowed to 
get engaged~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Th-That's just because... Opera O, 
this... this personage... couldn't eat the 
tendon!

It was beginning to look more like a 
manzai comedy routine, but... either way, 
the play barrelled straight through to the 
final curtain!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! I did totally terribly~! I'm so 
sorry, Opera O-san~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, what are you saying? Just listen 
to that voice!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Spe-chaaan! That was so funny!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I brought some snacks~! You must be 
starving!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, yakisoba and takoyaki...! That 
much!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! This is just proof that you've 
satisfied everyone!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Above all, facing the crisis of a missing 
cast member, your courage to step forward 
without hesitation!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And despite nearly faltering in the face 
of hardship, such nobility in seeing her 
role as the "Shogun" through to the very 
end!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Truly the caliber of a protagonist... You 
are indeed a splendid 
"Commander-in-Chief"!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A magnificent supreme commander... Me...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Wahahaha! You may raise your head! 
Truly, you may ease your mind!

...Though it seemed far from what she had 
envisioned, Special Week nevertheless 
showed off her fine (?) leadership as 
Supreme Commander.
